visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair stands in an indoor hallway/living room area, posing with a black cardigan over a white top and a grey long skirt. She wears black oval sunglasses. Text overlays announce 'Wearing & Styling ft. Gucci Sunglasses 2025 SS'. (2) The scene cuts to her in a white high-neck sleeveless top and denim shorts, wearing a blue cap with a yellow 'S' and the same sunglasses. She is holding a small white puppy. (3) She transitions through different outfits: a plaid shirt tied around her waist, and later a red and white striped crop top and skirt set. She poses elegantly, sometimes with a straw hat and a shell-like clutch. (4) Detailed close-up shots showcase the sunglasses, focusing on the gold frames, pearl embellishments on the temples, and the 'GUCCI' logo. (5) The woman interacts with her dog and poses for the camera in various fashion looks, consistently featuring the sunglasses as the central accessory.
